title: LF Networking Brings A2A-T to Live Network Through OpenAN
author: LFN

title: Zain Kuwait and Inspur Join OpenAN as Ecosystem Participants
author: OpenAN
content: Zain Kuwait, a leading telecom operator in the Middle East, and Inspur, a global provider of computing and AI infrastructure, have joined OpenAN as participants, expanding the ecosystem for agent-driven autonomous networks.
